independence_statement: I am the separately delegated reviewing model, not translator sa-0-b85253c3/deleg_48b394b4. I read the complete actual raw Arabic page and each complete target file, independently comparing English against Arabic and Indonesian against Arabic. The delegation brief was not treated as source evidence. I made no translation edits and consulted no neighboring page, normalized source, PDF, edition document, or PDF builder.

review_basis.source_representation: Actual canonical UTF-8 bytes, without normalization; 20 logical lines, LF separators, no terminal newline.
review_basis.scope: Complete physical page 104, both complete targets directly against Arabic, including folio, page-boundary fragments, all clauses and separators, captions and placeholder.
review_basis.frozen_reader_note: Optional reader check not used; this decision binds only the three enumerated source/target files.

raw_arabic_embeddings.EN: Exact raw source bytes at byte offset 8 after Arabic:\n; followed by two wrapper LF bytes and English:\n.
raw_arabic_embeddings.ID: Exact raw source bytes at byte offset 8 after Arabic:\n; followed by two wrapper LF bytes and Indonesia:\n.

script_scan.method: Every Unicode letter checked for Latin script or permitted transliteration modifier letters; non-ASCII decimal glyphs and hidden control characters separately rejected.

star_alignment.note: Target-only attribution notes are excluded by anchoring at the first translated prose line, not by assuming an unverified fixed offset. All three separators retain their clause boundaries.

mechanical_verification.schedule_tuple_method: Extracted complete number-word clauses directly from each file. Explicit source/EN/ID ordinal and weekday maps were used only for comparison; source bytes were not changed. All nine ordinal/day-or-night/weekday tuples match in exact order.
mechanical_verification.harness_diagnostic: The first embedding assertion assumed a single wrapper LF after a source-final newline. Raw-byte inspection established that this source has no terminal newline and the wrapper adds two LF bytes. The harness was corrected, not the files; the complete invariant checks were rerun successfully against the original three hashes.

coverage.item: Physical identity and anomalous printed folio
coverage.EN: Printed — ٦١ — is preserved as — 61 — with matching dash style; physical page 104 is not substituted for the folio, and no inferred 98 is introduced.
coverage.ID: Printed folio is likewise — 61 —, retaining its actual value independently of physical scan index.

coverage.item: Opening incomplete repetition fragment and damaged litany attachment
coverage.EN: Begins with the incomplete 'times,' without inventing a preceding count. The entirety of his litanies remains present, with a local uncertainty marker specifically qualifying its damaged connection to the following clause.
coverage.ID: Begins 'kali,' without a supplied count. 'Keseluruhan wiridnya' remains explicit, and the damaged attachment is qualified locally in Indonesian.

coverage.item: Distinct benefits, ladunniyyāt, religion and worldly life
coverage.EN: Good things, visits, and increases remain three distinct items; their hastening to him and the descent of ladunniyyāt are retained. Divinely bestowed knowledge is not changed into heavens. Blessing in both his religion and worldly life remains explicit.
coverage.ID: Kebaikan, kunjungan, and pertambahan remain distinct; their arrival and ladunniyyāt descending to him remain present. Agama and kehidupan dunia are both retained, without an invented reference to heavens.

coverage.item: Inner wonders, secrets, scarcely returning aspiration and divine love
coverage.EN: Retains witnessing wondrous things and strange secrets in himself, the limiting negation 'scarcely returns' and attachment to anyone among created beings. God Most High explicitly casts love for him into people's hearts. The invitation to contemplate and the greatest-secret description are retained.
coverage.ID: Retains wonders and strange secrets in himself; 'hampir tidak kembali' preserves the near-negation and 'seorang pun di antara makhluk' preserves the scope. Allah Yang Mahatinggi explicitly instills love for him in human hearts. Renungkanlah and rahasia terbesar remain.

coverage.item: Shaykh attribution, also, and seven ordered vocatives
coverage.EN: The shaykh is the quoted speaker; 'also' and the exalted Names are retained. Seven distinct O-vocatives match God, Samīʿ, Sarīʿ, Bāʿith, ʿAdl, Muʿīn, Faʿʿāl in source order, with glosses and distinguishing transliterations.
coverage.ID: Sang syekh is the speaker; 'juga' and the exalted Names remain. Seven Wahai/wahai vocatives preserve the same complete ordered identities without deduplication or substitution.

coverage.item: Recitation quantity, unspecified exalted hour, inward conditions and looking
coverage.EN: Seventy thousand times, not seventy-seven or another count; the exalted hour remains unspecified. Collected aspiration, a present heart, looking at the shape through the secret of the Jalālah, and then praying against the wrongdoer are preserved without added operational specifications.
coverage.ID: Tujuh puluh ribu kali is exact. Jam yang agung is not assigned a new time. Memusatkan cita batin, menghadirkan hati, looking through the secret of Jalālah and praying against the wrongdoer remain.

coverage.item: Opaque seizure/time construction and tyrant condition
coverage.EN: The recoverable seizure and time words in أخذه وقته remain, with actor and construction explicitly uncertain rather than a supplied death claim. Anyone wronged or subdued by a tyrant from among tyrants remains the subject of the following instruction.
coverage.ID: The taking/seizing and time fragments are retained with local uncertainty about actor and relationship; no invented death. Both being wronged and being subdued by a tyrant are retained as the condition.

coverage.item: Malformed yaḥūlu construction and before-week-completion scope
coverage.EN: فإنه يحول الله is not silently repaired to bi-ḥawl Allāh or a confident causal formula. 'Turns' is quoted and both the meaning of yaḥūlu and God's grammatical role are locally uncertain. The wrongdoer being seized before the week is complete remains explicit.
coverage.ID: Quoted 'beralih' is qualified by a local marker addressing both the verb's meaning and Allah's grammatical role. The source is not repaired into a familiar formula. The wrongdoer is direnggut before the week is complete.

coverage.item: Each-hour scope, opaque yklhā, wonders, reins, walls and divine epithets
coverage.EN: Do it in each of these hours remains explicit, not one selected hour. يكلها is preserved as opaque yklhā with reading and meaning uncertain, followed by the wonder of wonders. Draw in the reins, walls having ears, and God the Granter of success and Bestower all remain.
coverage.ID: Setiap jam preserves each-hour scope. Opaque yklhā and a localized Indonesian uncertainty marker precede the wonder claim. Tariklah tali kekang, dinding pun bertelinga, and both divine epithets are retained.

coverage.item: Parenthetical caption, bracketed image placeholder and absent geometry
coverage.EN: Both '(And this is the image of the shape)' and the separate '[Image of the shape]' translate their respective source items in the correct positions. No image, grid, cells or inferred geometry is invented.
coverage.ID: Both '(Dan inilah gambar bentuk itu)' and the separate '[Gambar bentuk itu]' are retained with their parenthetical/bracketed distinction and source order. No diagram contents are supplied.

coverage.item: Return to subject and complete forthcoming-wafq paragraph
coverage.EN: Return to the subject, the third separator, Know, the noble wafq to be mentioned next, operation in many special properties, abridging its explanation lest it fall into an ignorant person's hands, its form as seen, and God's granting both me and you success in understanding it are all retained.
coverage.ID: Return to the subject, separator and Ketahuilah precede the noble forthcoming wafq and its many properties. The abridgment's preventative purpose, ignorant recipient, visible form, and blessing for both aku and engkau in understanding it remain explicit.

coverage.item: Standalone final fragment and page boundary
coverage.EN: Final اعلم is a standalone 'Know', separated from the preceding paragraph; no following instruction or neighboring-page content completes it.
coverage.ID: Final fragment is standalone 'Ketahuilah', with no invented completion.

coverage.item: Full-page qualifications, honorifics, attribution and no augmentation
coverage.EN: All recoverable source clauses, repetitions, conditions, negative scope, named identities, possessives, divine honorifics and blessing recipients have been compared directly against Arabic. The added attribution note clearly marks the claims/instructions as the source's; no efficacy endorsement, new ritual detail, missing image content or source repair is introduced.
coverage.ID: Indonesian was independently compared to the complete Arabic, not accepted by agreement with English. Conditions, near-negation, temporal limit, each-hour scope, divine honorific and blessing recipients remain. The source-attribution note does not add an efficacy endorsement or operational detail.
